name: Fall Out Boy

whyMatters.en: Chicago emo/pop-punk four-piece formed in 2001. Dense lyric couplets and Stump melody on Sugar, We're Goin Down (2005) moved the band from Warped Tour scale to arenas; Centuries (2014) marked the post-hiatus stadium return.
whyMatters.zh: 芝加哥 emo/pop-punk 四人组，2001 年成立。Sugar, We're Goin Down（2005）以密歌词对句与 Stump 旋律，从 Warped Tour 体量进入体育场；Centuries（2014）标志停摆后的体育场回归。

lyricQuotes: We're going down, down in an earlier round / And Sugar, we're going down swinging
Some legends are told / Some turn to dust or to gold

shortBio.en: Chicago emo-punk four; From Under the Cork Tree breakthrough; Centuries as 2010s stadium return.
shortBio.zh: 芝加哥 emo-punk 四人；From Under the Cork Tree 突破；Centuries 作 2010 年代体育场回归。

body.en:
Formed in 2001 in Chicago hardcore/emo circles. Take This to Your Grave (2003) then From Under the Cork Tree (2005, Neal Avron): Sugar, We're Goin Down and Dance, Dance—Wentz dense couplets, Stump soul-edged melodic chorus, Trohman/Hurley punch.

Infinity on High (2007) added Thnks fr th Mmrs. Hiatus about 2009–2013; Save Rock and Roll and American Beauty/American Psycho yielded Centuries—chant stadium production with the same four names. Writing centers on lyric density plus pop chorus.
body.zh:
2001 年于芝加哥 hardcore/emo 圈组建。Take This to Your Grave（2003）再到 From Under the Cork Tree（2005，Neal Avron）：Sugar, We're Goin Down 与 Dance, Dance——Wentz 密对句、Stump 带 soul 边的旋律副歌、Trohman/Hurley 冲击。

Infinity on High（2007）加入 Thnks fr th Mmrs。约 2009–2013 停摆；Save Rock and Roll 与 American Beauty/American Psycho 产出 Centuries——口号体育场制作，仍是同一四人名。写作核心是歌词密度加流行副歌。

note.en: Cork Tree breakthrough; Wentz couplet and Stump chorus hook.
note.zh: Cork Tree 突破；Wentz 对句与 Stump 副歌钩子。

note.en: Syncopated verse punch; mid-2000s emo-punk radio pair with Sugar.
note.zh: 切分主歌冲击；与 Sugar 并列的 2000 年代中 emo-punk 电台曲。

note.en: Chant stadium single; post-hiatus American Beauty/American Psycho era.
note.zh: 口号体育场单曲；停摆后 American Beauty/American Psycho 期。

title.zh: 密歌词加 pop-punk 副歌

body.en:
Wentz writes stacked references and couplets; Stump sings them as R&B-aware pop melodies over Trohman power chords.

Sugar, We're Goin Down is the 2005 citation. Centuries later uses chant arena production over Warped-era grit.

Same four names; different mix loudness and hook scale.
body.zh:
Wentz 写叠引用与对句；Stump 用带 R&B 意识的流行旋律唱出，压 Trohman power chords。

Sugar, We're Goin Down 是 2005 引用曲。Centuries 后来用口号 arena 制作覆盖 Warped 期砂感。

同一四人名；混音响度与钩子体量不同。

body.en:
Early drummers rotated; Hurley locked in 2003. Stump, Wentz, Trohman, and Hurley held through hiatus and return.

No classic lineup fracture—the four names are the band.

Peak commercial units: Cork Tree 2005 and Centuries 2014.
body.zh:
早期鼓手轮换；Hurley 于 2003 年固定。Stump、Wentz、Trohman、Hurley 撑过停摆与回归。

无经典阵容分裂——四个名字即乐队。

商业巅峰单位：Cork Tree 2005 与 Centuries 2014。

body.en:
Mid-2000s peers (My Chemical Romance, Panic! at the Disco) shared the Warped-to-MTV path; Fall Out Boy leaned hardest into pop-chorus writing.

Centuries is often cited for 2010s emo-revival stadium production.

Debt to Green Day melody and hardcore scene energy.
body.zh:
2000 年代中同代（My Chemical Romance、Panic! at the Disco）共享 Warped 到 MTV 路径；Fall Out Boy 最用力做流行副歌写法。

Centuries 常被引作 2010 年代 emo 复兴体育场制作。

债务：Green Day 旋律与 hardcore 场景能量。
